verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's own materials list an "AI-powered subject line generator" and describe K:AI Composer. You tell Composer what you're trying to achieve and it drafts the content for your review, which covers AI drafting from a brief inside the platform. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of refining or rewriting existing copy, confirmation that the AI runs inside the email editor itself rather than a separate Composer workflow, in-depth feature docs beyond marketing and pricing pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
